title: feat(nm2frm2lx): L-path cyclic-frame transport -e3 then -e1 at t+1 on two-axis opposite seed: reverse HOLD, face fails
science: L-path (-e3 then -e1), per-site tau: the band's only bent path and its first 2-edge reverse HOLD. Both reverse probes complete (0,0,0)->(0,0,-1)->(-1,0,-1) and (0,1,0)->(0,1,-1)->(-1,1,-1) with frames at all three vertices; the face probes die at (-1,0,0)/(-1,1,0). Recomputed exactly. This is the closest the band comes to a path-dependence test and it misses: it shares no endpoint pair with any straight-path member, so it cannot compare two routes between the same two sites.
